title: Pica repository entry descriptor
description: `r/index.json`: which backend indexes this source provides, and where each one lives relative to `r/`. JSON Schema cannot express the path rules that matter here — no scheme, no host, no leading slash, no traversing segment, and nothing outside the tree after symlink resolution — so those are enforced by .github/scripts/repo_layout.py instead. This file pins the shape; that module pins the safety.

managers.description: One key per backend this source actually publishes. A backend with no packages must be absent rather than declared with an empty index: a client that trusted an empty declaration would resolve nothing.

path.description: Relative to `r/`. No download host, cache policy or server hint belongs in this file.
